name: Embraer Phenom 300
summary: The world's best-selling light jet for more than a decade, heavily used by fractional and charter fleets such as NetJets and Flexjet.

wings: Low swept wing with upturned winglets
engines: Two Pratt & Whitney Canada PW535E turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Curvy, smoothly rounded nose with a large windscreen
tail: T-tail with a sharply swept fin and swept horizontal stabilizer

tellTales: Upturned winglets on a light twinjet with a T-tail
Very large windows on a relatively short fuselage
Rounded, curvy nose blending into a big windscreen

confusedWith.howToTell: The Phenom 300 is longer with upturned winglets; the Phenom 100 is shorter with plain wingtips.
The Phenom 300 has winglets and much bigger windows; the CJ4 has plain wingtips and small windows.
The Phenom 300 has very large windows and a rounded nose; the Learjet 45/75 has small windows, a long pointed nose and small ventral fins under the tail.
The Phenom 300 has winglets and large windows; the Beechjet/Hawker 400 has plain wingtips and small windows.
The Premier I has plain wingtips with no winglets and smaller round windows; the Phenom 300 has upturned winglets and larger oval windows.
